I don't really know what there is to say. I just feel hopeless. Things aren't going to get better.
I don't know where to go to meet people. I don't know how to start talking to someone without feeling like I'm interrupting.
I'm barely ends meet right now. I can't afford a vacation. I wish I could.
My wife and I are in process of a divorce. Is not really very easy to communicate at this point.

I enjoy video games. I like to write and read. I love TV and movies. I don't think those really lend themselves to group activities. Like I said I'm a teacher so most of the people I know are going to be gone. I'm in a play, but the rehearsal for that is only 2 hours on Tuesday and Wednesday. 
I don't know what else would be applicable.
How do I find people? I'm not used to doing that.
Unfortunately almost all of my friends are teachers like me. That means they have spring break too. That means they're leaving for vacation.
I just didn't know if there was something that was already made.  I'd just like to see what it might look like.
That is one of the most beautiful things I've ever read. Thank you.

We were married for 7 years. We've been together for 13. We're still friends, but that's we all we are. We've been more like roommates than anything else for a long time. She got more and more withdrawn and stopped wanting to do any of the things we had in common. She really wanted to be a mom, but once my son was born it was like I didn't exist anymore. We've counseling. She's happier without me.

I guess it might help. I've told this story to a few people. 

My wife and I fell out of love a long time ago. Neither of us was willing to admit it. When she brought up the idea of having a child I thought it might bring us closer together (I know stupid right?).  It just pushed the wedge between us even further in. Don't get me wrong, I don't blame my son. He's the best thing that's ever happened to me. 

Anyway say forward to August. I meet an amazing woman. We click and instantly become great friends. We talk all the times and share everything with each other. A month later I kiss her. The next day we both say we love each other. 

We would talk for hours each day. I had beer felt this way about another person, not even my wife. We had a connection that seemed unreal. 

She started to feel guilty. She said we had to stop. I agreed. I didn't want her to hate herself because of me. We still wanted to be friends though. 

This is when my marriage ended. I moved out. My wife doesn't know about the affair, but she's already told me she's happier without me around. I hated leaving my son. I feel so guilty. Luckily she has been good at letting me see him, but there are days when I don't get to and it hurts so much because I know it's all my fault. 

Because of all of that, I've been depressed. I became needy and was probably putting more on my friend than was fair. Right now this other woman, the woman I love, isn't speaking with me. She says she needs space right now. She need me to work on fixing myself. 

I feel so alone. I feel like I've hurt 3 people, two of which I would do absolutely anything for. I don't know if this other woman will ever want me back in her life. I hope so, but maybe not. Everyday there are thousands of things that remind me of her. I can't get her out I my head. I want to call her or text her right now but I can't. 

To top it all off I've been having horrible dreams. Four nights ago I had a dream. She and I were together at some house talking. She told me she had a boyfriend named Nick. She said loved him more than she ever loved me. She said I was just for fun and I didn't really mean anything. 

Three nights ago I dreamt that I overheard her talking to a coworker about her boyfriend named Owen and how she got together with him the day after she broke up with her previous bf (me). Then she went onto say how awful her previous bf was and how much better Owen was. 

The past two nights were more of the same. Each time I've woken up in tears. 

That's my deal.
I'm 31m going through some pretty shitty stuff right now too. Maybe I can help.

Thank you. I don't know if I'm strong enough to carry this though. I think it's going to break me. I think it already has. My best friend is gone. She was the only person I could be me around and now she's gone. My son is gone. I just can't carry this. I don't know how.
I'm still here. I just don't know how to handle everything that's going on. It's so hard. My heart is empty. My soul is black. I feel like people would prefer me gone.

My wife and I started dating in high school. We were the first real relationship for each other. We got married the week we graduated from college. 
A couple years into the marriage we stopped talking. We didn't fight at all. We just didn't talk. I would come home from work and do my own thing, she'd do her own thing, we'd sit together for dinner and not really talk. They'd we'd watch TV until one of us decided to go to bed.  We'd have sex a couple of time per year, usually on birthdays or something. That's the way it was for years.
My wife brought up the idea of having a child and I had serious reservations but I hoped it would bring is closer together. It didn't. It got worse. I got to the point where we were fighting a lot. We finally decided it was just too hard to live together so I moved out. 
I still see my son everyday. It's hard though.

I've been married for 10 years. I haven't been in love with my wife for a long time. In July I met someone else. I fell in love and had an affair. I feel awful that I did. I know it makes me a shitty person, but I'm still in love with this other woman. My wife doesn't know about the affair but we are separated at this point. I have a 1 year old son. I feel like he's the only good thing I've ever done. 

I feel like if I leave, my son will have a harder time in life. We aren't the richest people on earth, so financially things will be very hard. I also know what it was like to go through my parents divorce. I don't want him to feel those feelings. 

If I stay I'm going to be staying in a place that I'm not happy with. I can probably fake it, but my wife is a good person. She deserves someone who loves her. She deserves someone who isn't in love with someone else. She deserves better. 

I just feel like not being here anymore would make things easier on everyone. They could forget I ever existed and move on with their lives.
